title: Sources & further reading
body:
Primary/official sources checked directly for this guide: Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026 official announcement · Japan MOFA — visa exemption · Japan Tourism Agency — tax-free system change, Nov 1 2026 · JR Kyushu Rail Pass · JR Hokkaido — scenic tour trains · JR East — Suica/PASMO sales status · Seven Bank — foreign-card ATM access · Zao Ropeway — operating season · Federal Reserve H.10 — JPY/USD reference rate.

Also checked directly: JNTO — Matsushima · JNTO — Jigokudani, Noboribetsu · Visit Miyagi — Naruko Gorge · Shin Shin ramen, Tenjin · Ganso Nagahamaya · Ganso Motsunabe Rakutenchi · Fukuya mentaiko, Nakasu · Animate Fukuoka · Animate Sapporo · Animate Sendai · jozankei.jp — official autumn hiking trails · Zao Town tourism association · Ubigi Japan eSIM rates · Yamato Ta-Q-Bin.

Rain plans and crowd-timing sources, checked the same way: Sapporo Beer Museum — rain plan_b for Mt. Moiwa · Otaru Music Box Museum — rain plan_b for Otaru · Yumoto Sagiriyu — rain plan_b for Jigokudani · SHIKAnoYU day-use onsen — rain plan_b for Jozankei · Former Hokkaido Government Office (Akarenga) — rain plan_b for Maruyama Park · Crossroad Fukuoka (prefectural tourism) — Yanagibashi Rengo Ichiba hours & closed days · Ofukazawa Promenade, Naruko Gorge · Yamadera opening-hour crowd timing · Mt. Moiwa night-view crowd timing · Otaru North Canal / Ryūgū Bridge.

Pass B's novel local picks, each verified to its own source: Akaiwa no Ma, Jozankei · Tetarazu Kaihin Park, Matsushima · Nagahama yatai district · Tanyaki Ichiryu Honten, Sendai · gop no Anagura, Sapporo · TICRO MARKET, Fukuoka · Hakata-ben phrases · Sendai/Miyagi-ben phrases · Hokkaido-ben phrases.

Secondary/community leads (used to find the above, never cited as fact on their own): Fukuoka Now (resident magazine), Yahoo Chiebukuro local Q&A threads, Visit Miyagi and Tohoku Kanko regional tourism sites, japan-guide.com, watabi.org's 2026 koyo forecast roundup, and assorted r/JapanTravel-adjacent forum/blog discussion.

What changed on review. Facts carried forward from an earlier pass on this same trip kept their original verification dates where unchanged; the Zao Ropeway closure assumption was corrected against the operator's own page, and the domestic-flights/Shinkansen-fare misattribution was separated into distinct sourced rows.

A later fidelity spot-check re-read each cited page against the value it was supporting, and moved the Zao Ropeway round-trip fare onto the operator's own published figure — the town tourism page it had been credited to carries no ropeway fare at all. An independent local/authentic research pass then corroborated the crowd-timing notes on Naruko Gorge, Yamadera, Mt. Moiwa, and Otaru Canal, and added Tetarazu Kaihin Park, Akaiwa no Ma, the Nagahama yatai district, Tanyaki Ichiryu Honten, gop no Anagura, and TICRO MARKET as novel alternatives — full reconciliation trail in the intake doc.

Every fact above carries its own source and checked date inline in the section it appears in — this list is a jumping-off point for your own pre-trip re-checks, not a substitute for the per-section citations.
